name: 鵪鶉

iucn.assessmentNote: 全球NT；香港稀少過境／冬候鳥

illustrationTaxon: Coturnix japonica adult male; main image and diagnostic features

similarSpecies.distinction: 黃腳三趾鶉體型更小（15–18 cm，約鵪鶉的75%），喙腳偏黃；飛起時上翼淺色覆羽與深色飛羽反差明顯。鵪鶉稍大（17–19 cm），飛行上翼較素、外側初級飛羽較長。
中華鷓鴣明顯較大型（約31–34 cm）、具黑白面紋框白頰、黑底白點胸脇及栗冠側；鵪鶉只有17–19 cm，雄鳥紅褐臉喉、寬奶油眉紋及淡褐胸脇。

featureNotes: 雄鳥紅褐臉喉，配上寬闊奶油色眉紋與深色頭冠
淡色眉紋從眼上延伸，與深色冠部形成對比
胸脇帶暖淡褐色，羽毛有細碎斑駁而非大片白斑
上翼褐色細紋相對素雅；與三趾鶉飛行時淺覆羽、深飛羽的強烈反差不同

rangeMap.note: Partial country overview of broad breeding and wintering range described by HKBWS: breeding from the Lake Baikal area east/southeast to Sakhalin, northeast China and northern Japan; wintering on the Korean Peninsula, southern Japan, much of China south of the Yellow River and northern Indochina west to Myanmar. Selected countries are highlighted only as an overview; green does not mean entire-country occupancy, seasonal boundaries are not distinguished, and this is not a precise range polygon. Hong Kong's passage/winter records are not depicted as resident range.

sources.use: Full HKBWS account read: Japanese Quail 17–19 cm; male rufous face/throat, broad creamy supercilium, dark crown, buff chest/flanks; female duller with dark breast mottling. In Hong Kong scarce autumn migrant, rare winter and spring migrant; most records Oct–Feb, with weak passage to mid-May. IUCN Near Threatened, trend suspected moderately rapid decline due to hunting/agricultural change. Breeding range Lake Baikal east/southeast to Sakhalin, northeast China, northern Japan; winters Korean Peninsula, southern Japan, much of China south of Yellow River, and northern Indochina west to Myanmar. The source notes flight separation from buttonquails: Japanese Quail is slightly larger, has plain upperwings and longer outer wing. Local status and global IUCN are distinct.
Cornell eBird/Merlin species account for cross-checking Japanese Quail field marks and species identity.

Full HKBWS Yellow-legged Buttonquail account read: 15–18 cm, about 75% Japanese Quail size, yellowish bill/legs, patterned upperparts; flushed birds show contrast between pale upperwing coverts and darker flight feathers. Female/immature plumage duller/greyer than orange-brown-headed male. Hong Kong rare passage migrant; global IUCN LC. Supports explicitly labelled extralimital comparator, not conflation with Japanese Quail.

Full HKBWS Chinese Francolin account read for comparator: much larger, male black face pattern surrounding white cheeks and throat, rufous crown sides, white-spotted dark body and yellowish-orange legs.
